_source: OSRS Wiki: Bank_PIN; the Banker's transcript ("I'd like to check my PIN settings." -> open_interface "Bank PIN"); the cache's bankpin_settings and bankpin_keypad interfaces and their client scripts (333 -> 653 shuffles the keypad and prompts for each digit; 685 sends the four digits as one resume_countdialog); rsprox.net recordings 7 (rev 223: the settings screen and the logout toggle), 4194 (rev 238) and 2246 (rev 228): the keypad at a bank and "You have correctly entered your PIN."
_numbers: Components with no gameval name, by their file id (the dump of each interface): settings 10 the logout output, 14 the message box text, 20 and 24 the two recovery-delay buttons, 21 the has-a-PIN buttons layer.

keypad.instruction: Please enter your PIN using the buttons below.
keypad._again: Calibrated: the second entry when setting or changing a PIN.
keypad.again: Now please enter that number again.

_guardTitles: The keypad's title for each "bank-pin:guard" feature. Recorded: grand-exchange (rsprox 3250), bond (1375). Anything else shows the bank's title, uncalibrated.
_guardShops: shops.json ids of the point shops the Wiki lists: 1449 Last Man Standing, 1450 Leagues, 1459 PvP Arena, 1465 Speedrunning, 1481 Events.
_defaultDelay: Calibrated: the Wiki says a new PIN takes effect in 7 days.
_lockout: Wiki: after two failed attempts a 10-second lockout, after another 15 seconds, after four 10 minutes; logging out doesn't reset the count. Seconds.

texts.noPin: You do not have a PIN
texts._recorded: message, alwaysLockMessage and lockAfterMessage-like lines: the message box's recorded texts; the rest calibrated.
texts.message: Customers are reminded that they should NEVER tell anyone their Bank PINs or passwords, nor should they ever enter their PINs on any website form.
texts.alwaysLockMessage: On login, your PIN will always be locked.
texts.lockAfterMessage: If you log back in within 5 minutes, your PIN will stay unlocked.
texts.pendingMessage: Your new PIN will be active in [days] days. Until then you can cancel it here.
texts.pendingDeleteMessage: Your PIN will be deleted in [days] days. You can cancel this here if you remember it.
texts.deleteQuestion: Do you really wish to delete your PIN?

messages._recorded: correct is recorded; the rest are calibrated (the Wiki paraphrases the lockout's advice).
messages.correct: You have correctly entered your PIN.
messages.enterFirst: You need to enter your Bank PIN at a bank first.
messages.lockedOut: You have entered your PIN incorrectly too many times. If you made a mistake, use the 'cancel' option. Please wait [seconds] seconds before trying again.
messages.mismatch: Those numbers did not match. Your PIN has not been set.
messages.set: Your new PIN will be active in [days] days.
messages.cancelled: The pending change to your PIN has been cancelled.
messages.forgot: Your PIN will be deleted in [days] days.
messages.active: Your Bank PIN is now active.
messages.removed: Your Bank PIN has now been deleted.
